historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved a Section 309 determination of compliance and exceptions to construct a 75-foot tall, seven-story building with nine residential units and 3,500 square feet of office space.
The City Planning Commission approved a conditional use authorization for five non-accessory parking spaces.
